beats.say: You book your train tickets on IRCTC, but the thing that cost it a hundred and sixteen crore this quarter is a water bottle.
July to September, its sales grew sixteen percent. Profit fell twenty-three percent, to two hundred and sixty-four crore rupees.
lines: Down from ₹342 crore a year ago

beats.say: Blame Rail Neer, its bottled water. A GST tribunal says IRCTC overcharged, so it set aside a hundred and sixteen crore, with interest.
lines: GST tribunal order, IRCTC is appealing

beats.say: Now the twist. Train food brought in six hundred and fifty-five crore, but kept just ten rupees of every hundred.
Ticket booking kept eighty-four. The website you curse every Tatkal morning is the real money machine. Send this to whoever books your tickets.
lines: Send this to your family's ticket booker
